connector.name: Inbin
connector.registryDescription: Query Inbin's parsed email events (newsletters, invoices, alerts) as typed JSON tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.inbin.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the yaotsakpo account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

env.name: INBIN_API_KEY
env.description: Your Inbin API key (starts with ink_live_). Get one at https://inbin.dev/dashboard.
